target_customer: Engineering, product and design teams at software companies
problem: Bugs and UX issues reach users before teams notice. Interfere monitors production apps, flags behavior changes, finds root causes and suggests fixes linked to the codebase.
product_category: AI production monitoring and issue triage

founders.name: Luke Shiels
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page; background not stated there.

competitors.name: Sentry with Seer
competitors.what: Error tracking, session replay with AI summaries and root cause suggestions

competitors.name: Highlight.io
competitors.what: Open-source session replay, errors and logs

technical_complexity.rationale: Needs instrumentation, replay, anomaly detection and code-linked fixes with LLMs; standard but broad.

defensibility.rationale: Established monitoring vendors already add AI triage, so the moat is integration depth and speed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Sentry shipped Seer AI and replay summaries; no acquisition of Interfere found.

market_need_then: Teams pay for monitoring and replay tools and AI coding raised release volume, increasing demand for automated detection of unseen issues.

branding.domain_note: Uses the exact .com interfere.com; acquisition details not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: confident, benefit-led: 'Ship software that never breaks'

brand_strength.rationale: Exact-match .com and a distinct word, but 'interfere' has a negative connotation for a monitoring product; no brand press found.

outcome_analysis: Interfere is an active Summer 2025 company with one named founder and no verified funding. It enters a market where Sentry and LogRocket already ship AI triage, so outcomes depend on execution and differentiation. Too little reliable data exists to judge success or failure.
notes: A Dealroom news note (and Signalbase) report a $5.1M seed led by Hummingbird Ventures; the round rests on these outlets and no date was obtained (Dealroom page returned 429). Startup Intros separately lists a $2M seed dated 2025-06-01 and a $3M seed dated 2025-10-01, and VCBacked $3.4M total; these conflict and are not summed or recorded. Founder background not found.
